amendments.normalized_body: In `emit_molt_failure` (shrimp.rs:1445-1455), the new `else` branch unconditionally pushes a "score X<Y" detail to every molt failure event that is not a critical GH failure. The original code had no else branch, so this is a new behavioral change that adds diagnostic text to event summaries. While arguably an improvement, any downstream code or tests that parse or match on exact event summary strings could break silently. Consider adding a test that asserts the "score" detail IS present in the non-critical-GH failure case, not only that "critical GH ratio" is absent.
